meta.title: Glyph whales
meta.description: Five species of text whales cruise, stroke their horizontal flukes vertically, and glide below the conversation.

ui.title: Glyph whales
ui.purpose: Look straight down through the interface as a sea surface. Each species has its own head, flippers and flukes. Calm cruising alternates vertical tail strokes with glides. Raised backs are darker; flanks and deeper water are paler.
ui.enabledHint: Visible on the conversation page. Stops on other pages.
ui.countHint: 1 to 8 whales with different sizes and depths.
ui.textHint: Repeats these characters to form each whale. Spaces are ignored. Leave blank to use 探索未至之境. Up to 40 characters.
ui.speedHint: 0.3 to 2. Default 0.65. Scales cruising, turning and tail beats, with glides between strokes.
ui.opacityHint: 0.04 to 0.9. Default 0.6. Higher values make the body text clearer.
ui.glyphSizeHint: 4 to 16. Default 11. Characters occupy separate, fixed grid cells.
ui.whaleSizeHint: 0.55 to 1.55. Default 1. Changes body length only, not swimming speed; larger whales cover more cells.
ui.colorHint: Choose the ocean palette for both glyphs and colored cells.
ui.quietCenterHint: Fades whale bodies in the center. The bottom input area always fades out.
ui.leftInsetHint: 0 to 500 pixels. Default 280. Desktop follows the sidebar automatically. In a browser, adjust this to match its width.
ui.glassHint: Every content card and the input box gets frosted: whales show through only as blurred shapes while the text stays crisp. On by default; use either this or input-box avoidance, not both.
ui.glassStrengthHint: 0 to 1. Default 0.55. Higher values make the glass thicker and blurrier, so less of the whale shows through.
ui.composerGlass: Frosted input box (folded into content boxes)
ui.composerGlassHint: The separate 0.10.0 input-box switch; since 0.11.0 it is part of the frosted content boxes. Kept only to read old configs.
ui.composerAvoidHint: Whales treat the input box as an obstacle and swim around it instead of crossing it. Use either this or the frosted content boxes, not both.
ui.spoutHint: On by default. Each whale occasionally lets out a short mist from its blowhole, and stays quiet while submerged. The mist fades and does not become a fountain.
ui.windHint: Sparse aligned surface strokes drift with the breeze, appearing and fading gently. On by default.
ui.cloudsHint: Soft, slow-moving ASCII shadows cross the sea and slightly shade whale ink while respecting reading areas. On by default.
ui.ripplesHint: Swimming and gliding leave an ASCII wake that spreads and fades along the trail. Strong tail strokes add a brief splash. Submerged whales stop making new wakes.
ui.invalid: Enter numbers within the listed ranges. Count, size, and inset must be whole numbers.
ui.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere, or the save was refused. Your edits are preserved. Reload saved values before editing again.
ui.failed: Could not save. Your edits are preserved and can be retried.
ui.speciesHint: Mixed groups cycle through blue, humpback, sperm, fin and bowhead whales. Or choose one species.
ui.renderStyleHint: Glyphs draws letters only. Colored cells add shaded backgrounds inside the whale, with soft glyph-only edges.
ui.fillModeHint: Custom text keeps your original characters. ASCII selects symbols by density and shading. Either works with colored cells.
ui.stylePreview: Live whale preview of the current draft
ui.stylePreviewNote: The preview scales the conversation background uniformly, keeping characters and whales in proportion. Changes appear live; save to apply them. The card at the lower right demonstrates glass and avoidance.
